# eurodns_record_set (Resource)

All records of one name and type (an RRset) in a EuroDNS zone. Creation fails if the RRset already exists: import it instead. Records not managed by this resource are written back unchanged on every save.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "eurodns_record_set" "www" {
  zone   = "example.com"
  host   = "www"
  type   = "CNAME"
  ttl    = 3600
  values = ["www.example.net."]
}

resource "eurodns_record_set" "apex" {
  zone   = "example.com"
  host   = "@"
  type   = "A"
  ttl    = 600
  values = ["192.0.2.10", "192.0.2.11"]
}

# TXT values are sent raw: no surrounding quotes.
resource "eurodns_record_set" "spf" {
  zone   = "example.com"
  host   = "@"
  type   = "TXT"
  ttl    = 3600
  values = ["v=spf1 include:_spf.example.net -all"]
}

# Names must end with a dot, otherwise EuroDNS makes them relative to the zone.
resource "eurodns_record_set" "mail" {
  zone   = "example.com"
  host   = "@"
  type   = "MX"
  values = ["10 mx1.example.net.", "20 mx2.example.net."]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `host` (String) Name relative to the zone, lowercase, `@` for the apex (for example `www`, `_acme-challenge.www`). Changing it moves the RRset in place, in a single zone save. A host unknown at plan time (for example taken from an ACM certificate being created) plans an update, and nothing is written if it resolves to the current host.
- `type` (String) Record type: A, AAAA, CNAME, MX, NS, PTR, SRV, TXT, SPF, CAA, APEX, TLSA, SVCB, HTTPS, DS. SOA and apex NS records are locked by EuroDNS and cannot be managed. Changing it replaces the RRset in place, in a single zone save (for example `A` to `CNAME`, or `A` to `APEX`).
- `values` (Set of String) Record data (rdata), one entry per record, sent to EuroDNS as is. Names (CNAME, MX, NS, SRV... targets) must end with a dot: EuroDNS treats names without a trailing dot as relative to the zone. TXT values are sent raw: do not wrap them in quotes.
- `zone` (String) Zone (domain) name, for example `example.com`. Changing it replaces the record set.

### Optional

- `ttl` (Number) TTL in seconds, one of the values EuroDNS accepts: 600, 900, 1800, 3600, 7200, 14400, 21600, 43200, 86400, 172800, 432000, 604800. Default 3600.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) `<zone>/<host>/<type>`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# <zone>/<host>/<type>. In gate mode, the import first asks the gate to adopt
# the existing RRset (requires the dns.record.adopt permission).
terraform import eurodns_record_set.www example.com/www/CNAME
```
